name: Resolution Recommender
fn: Suggests resolution actions from historical exception patterns
detail: Recommends the most likely resolution for an exception by retrieving how similar past exceptions were cleared (kNN over resolution history). Gives analysts a one-click answer instead of a research task.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST
